_note: Values for a 1080x1920 frame, px. Each platform: rectangle margins plus extra exclusion boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Update source/checked when you re-check. The engine intersects all platforms of a plan.

youtube_shorts.kind: official Google Ads template for vertical video, used as an approximation for organic Shorts

youtube.kind: vertical export for a regular YouTube upload uses the Shorts zone

tiktok.source: https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/tiktok-auction-in-feed-ads (official safe-zone template 720x1280: top 160, bottom 440, sides 80, action column 120 px wide from y 560; scaled x1.5; pixel values read via adkit.so/tools/safe-zones/tiktok)
tiktok.kind: official In-Feed ad template, TikTok says the zone also depends on caption length; organic posts use the same UI

reels.source: https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/video/instagram-reels (Meta: keep top 14%, bottom 35%, 6% each side free)
reels.kind: official Meta ads guide percentages converted to px
